title: 第023章 跟我道歉你不配第024章 拜会金家
content_zh:
第023章跟我道歉，你不配
其实，金佩云原本无需对陈默这般恭敬，但是，金佩云是个聪明人，她明白现在给陈默多一分尊重，将来，就能多获得陈默一份好感。
这个投资，不用花费一分钱，却能收获巨大的效益。
陈默也能明白金佩云的心思，但，他对此很受用，在心里，已经接受了金佩云抛出的橄榄枝。
“你来得不早不晚，刚刚好。”陈默看着金佩云，淡淡说道，话里有话。
金佩云脸色一红，她自然听出了陈默话中责怪的意思，明白这是在怪她没有早点出手解围。
“你奶奶的病，应该好了吧！”陈默接着问道，虽然是问，可却用了肯定语气，很明显，他对自己的符箓很自信。
“多亏陈先生，奶奶已无大碍！”金佩云躬身道。
“那就好。”陈默点点头，不在说话。
“陈先生，我爷爷想当面对你道谢，不知道你能否赏脸，跟我回家一趟？”金佩玉恭谨的询问。
其实，她已经改变了金中润的原意，按照金中润对她的交待，一旦发现陈默踪迹，他要亲自登门拜访。
不过，金佩云依旧有自己的小心思，她不想让金家在陈默面前，表现的太过卑躬屈膝。
听到金佩云的话，何红冰心中又是一惊：金佩云的爷爷，那不是金家的主人，金老将军吗？
这个少年居然能得到金老将军亲自邀请，怕是武州柿长都没这份殊荣，这个高三学生，究竟是什么来头？
陈默却挥挥手，淡淡道：“不必了，你已经付出了报酬，咱们各取所需，道谢的话，就算了吧，正好最近我也比较忙，一时半会走不开。”
何红冰看着陈默，心脏再次如遭重击：“他，他竟然决绝了！”
金老将军的邀请，是武州多少大人物梦寐以求的殊荣，可是，他竟然拒绝了？
何红冰突然觉得，自己不是坐井观天，根本就是井底之蛙，不，井底之蚁！
金佩云也是微微错愕，身为金家人，她自然知道自己爷爷的邀请，所代表的意义有多重，可是陈默竟然拒绝了，而且没有丝毫犹豫。
金佩云有些生气，她觉得陈默未免有些年轻气盛，根本不明白金家这两个字所代表的实力与地位！

但是，金佩云没有忘记她爷爷交代，再次躬身行礼，毕恭毕敬说道：“既然陈先生不方便，那我便回去告知爷爷，改日，他老人家定当登门拜访！”
这次，何红冰连哭都忘了，只是呆呆的看着陈默，就像一个没有感知的木偶。他，已经不知道该如何表达自己心中的震撼了！
张虎更是吓的瑟瑟发抖，看着陈默如同见鬼一般，金佩云就已经是他这辈子只能仰望的大人物了，那她的爷爷呢？
张虎觉得贫穷已经限制了他的想象，更让他无法想象的是，这么一位大人物身后更大的大人物，居然要亲自拜访陈默，拜访眼前这个高中生！
张虎甚至觉得，是不是自己今天出门的方式不对？撞邪了？
content_en:
Chapter 023 Apologize to me, you don’t deserve it
In fact, Jin Peiyun did not need to be so respectful to Chen Mo. However, Jin Peiyun is a smart person. She understands that giving Chen Mo more respect now will gain Chen Mo's favor in the future.
This investment does not cost a penny, but can reap huge benefits.
Chen Mo could also understand Jin Peiyun's thoughts, but he was very useful to it, and in his heart, he had accepted Jin Peiyun's olive branch.
"You came neither early nor late, just right." Chen Mo looked at Jin Peiyun and said lightly, with something in his words.
Jin Peiyun's face turned red. She naturally heard the blame in Chen Mo's words, and understood that he was blaming her for not taking action to rescue him earlier.
"Your grandma's illness should be cured!" Chen Mo then asked. Although he was asking, he used a positive tone. It was obvious that he was very confident in his talisman.
"Thanks to Mr. Chen, grandma is fine!" Jin Peiyun bowed.
"That's good." Chen Mo nodded and stopped talking.
"Mr. Chen, my grandfather wants to thank you in person. I wonder if you can give me a favor and come home with me?" Jin Peiyu asked respectfully.
In fact, she has changed Jin Zhongrun's original intention. According to Jin Zhongrun's explanation to her, once Chen Mo is found, he will visit him personally.
However, Jin Peiyun still had her own small thoughts. She didn't want the Jin family to behave too groveling in front of Chen Mo.
Hearing Jin Peiyun's words, He Hongbing was shocked again: Jin Peiyun's grandfather, isn't that the master of the Jin family, Old General Jin?
This young man was actually invited personally by General Jin. I am afraid even Wuzhou Shizhang did not have this honor. What is the background of this senior high school student?
Chen Mo waved his hand and said calmly: "No need, you have already paid the reward. Let's each get what we need. If you say thank you, forget it. I happen to be quite busy recently and I won't be able to leave for a while."
He Hongbing looked at Chen Mo, and her heart felt like a heavy blow again: "He, he actually decided!"
Old General Jin's invitation was an honor coveted by many big shots in Wuzhou, but he actually refused?
He Hongbing suddenly felt that instead of sitting in a well and looking at the sky, he was basically a frog at the bottom of the well, no, an ant at the bottom of the well!
Jin Peiyun was also slightly surprised. As a member of the Jin family, she naturally knew the significance of her grandfather's invitation, but Chen Mo actually refused without any hesitation.
Jin Peiyun was a little angry. She felt that Chen Mo was a bit young and arrogant, and did not understand the strength and status represented by the two words "Jin family"!
However, Jin Peiyun did not forget her grandfather's instructions, and bowed again and said respectfully: "Since it is inconvenient for Mr. Chen, I will go back and tell grandpa that he will definitely come to visit you some other day!"
This time, He Hongbing even forgot to cry, and just stared at Chen Mo blankly, like an unconscious puppet. He no longer knew how to express the shock in his heart!
Zhang Hu was even more frightened and trembling. He looked at Chen Mo as if he had seen a ghost. Jin Peiyun was already a big shot that he could only look up to in his life. What about her grandfather?
Zhang Hu felt that poverty had limited his imagination, and what was even more unimaginable to him was that an even bigger figure behind such a big figure actually wanted to personally visit Chen Mo and the high school student in front of him!
Zhang Hu even felt that the way he went out today was wrong? Got hit by something evil?
